data_fields.name: sale_percent_per_entry
data_fields.donor_constant: from price sheet (value not read); used only when 0 < pct < 100

data_fields.name: rounding_granularity
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 default; 100 for several currencies; 1000 KRW; 50000 VND; 500 CRC

data_fields.name: rounding_half_rule
data_fields.donor_constant: round up when remainder >= granularity/2 or value < granularity

data_fields.name: rental_share_pct
data_fields.donor_constant: default 100 (not rentable); rentable only when 0 < scale < 100; max over category tags

data_fields.name: preview_period_discount
data_fields.donor_constant: from price sheet key preview_period_discount (value not read)

data_fields.name: bundle_discount_requires_below_sum
data_fields.donor_constant: discount only when bundle current price < sum of parts (strict)

best_idea: Show a discount only when the price really is lower: a sale must be positive and below base, and a bundle shows a discount only when it costs less than its parts, with the struck-out base set to the sum of the parts.
decision_why: Take the two discount-truth rules and the never-to-zero rounding for shop prices; take the timed market refresh as stale-while-revalidate but keep the server as owner; reject the client-side market price as displayed truth and reject a rental number without a unit name, because the donor reads the same number two ways.
acceptance: A bundle at 900 with parts summing to 1000 shows base 1000 struck and a discount; a bundle at 1000 shows no strike-through; a 1% sale on a 100-gold item that rounds back to 100 shows no sale; a rental line shows the same charge in the detail view and the cart, with one named unit.
